verdict.rationale: Workable documents a built-in 'Workable Agent' that takes over top-of-funnel recruiting work (sourcing, screening and qualifying candidates) and returns a shortlist. AI-assisted candidate search and AI recommendations support this further. The evidence is thin marketing copy, and the delegation is limited to the sourcing and screening domain rather than a general in-product assistant. Missing for 10: details on how users assign or steer tasks for the agent, scope beyond sourcing and screening, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
Receive AI-generated recommendations of qualified candidates based on your job ad from a pool of 400 million profiles.
